notes.title: Content update and fixes
notes.notes:
- 2 new Deathmatch levels!
- Skills are usable with key binds 1, 2, 3 on PC.
- Skill buttons have key bind labels (1, 2, 3).
- Player can open/close menu/scoreboard with the "ESC" key on PC.
- Menu/scoreboard now has key bind label (ESC).
- Reload has key bind "R" on PC. Both weapons are reloaded if magazine is not full.
- Reload has key bind labels (R).
- Mouse cursor got new graphics and the cursor is no longer visible or usable in game.
- Sound levels tuning.
- Explosion graphics tuning.
